def priority(f):
    dist = f['distance']
    ret = f['return_distance']
    nr = f['nearest_remaining']
    reg = f['regret']
    cd = f['cluster_density']
    prog = f['progress']
    rw = 0.15 + 0.35 * prog
    rp = rw * ret
    np = 0.20 * nr
    rb = 0.25 * reg
    db = 0.05 * cd
    return -dist + rp + np + rb + db
